svg.title: Receipt call 688: Go and the system sampler slow together
svg.desc: A 2.28 second Receipt hit contains a 1.675 second Go probe. The separate system sampler takes 1.678 seconds over almost the same interval. These clocks do not identify OS thread states or prove a shared cause. Go reports 75.588 milliseconds CPU; Receipt reports 1.023 milliseconds GC pauses.

g.text: Call 688 · same horizontal clock · no native thread-state trace
Start 60 ms → Wait returns after another 1,615 ms
Reported CPU: 76 ms (its location on this clock is unknown)
Receipt GC pauses total 1.02 ms; Go-child GC was not recorded in this batch.
The overlapping delays suggest shared contention. They do not identify the waiting resource.
*Unix timestamp span rounded; monotonic external duration is 2,279.595 ms. Other spans use parent clocks.
